sanskrit_verse: नग्नो मुण्डः कपालेन भिक्षार्थी क्षुत्पिपासितः। दीनः शत्रुगृहं गच्छेद् यः साक्ष्यमनृतं वदेत्॥
transliteration: nagno muṇḍaḥ kapālena bhikṣārthī kṣutpipāsitaḥ | dīnaḥ śatrugṛhaṃ gacched yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who, though emaciated by hunger and thirst, destitute and shaved clean, approaches the house of an enemy merely to bear false witness — such a being acts from the collapse of dharma within consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises only where integrity is present
Causation originates in the distortion of satyam (truth)
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to one's alignment with atmic clarity
Restoration logic requires reconnection with svadharma through purification
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of testimony
executable_legal_axioms: IF testimony_motive = desperation OR enmity THEN disqualify_as_evidence_source
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any testimony rendered under conditions of compromised consciousness or adversarial motivation must be excluded from evidentiary consideration. The court must assess not only factual accuracy but also ontological alignment of the witness with satyam. Where testimony stems from desperation or enmity, it reflects a failure of dharma rather than adhikara (authority) to testify.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality locates falsehood not in malicious intent alone but in the misalignment of consciousness from satyam. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that false speech emerges consequent to inner impoverishment. Responsibility lies in restoring the capacity for truthful perception, not in inflicting punitive consequence. Nyaya demands completion of integrity, not vengeance upon error.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma reorientation process for the witness
Assign completion task: practice of satyam-vāk for 21 days under supervision
Reconnect individual with community dharmic structures
Facilitate śuddhi samskara to restore clarity of perception
Establish mentorship protocol until witness integrity is re-established
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam: False witness arises from dharma-collapse; therefore, restoration precedes rejection. Truth is not enforced, it is realized. This law flows from the Supreme Source, beyond punishment, toward pure consciousness realignment. Dharma is restored.
